name: Poké Ball ×5
description: Adds 5 Poké Balls to your bag.

name: Great Ball ×5
description: Adds 5 Great Balls to your bag.

name: Ultra Ball ×5
description: Adds 5 Ultra Balls to your bag.

name: Rogue Ball ×5
description: Adds 5 Rogue Balls to your bag.

name: Master Ball ×1
description: Adds 1 Master Ball to your bag.

name: Rare Candy
description: Increases a Pokémon’s level by 1.

name: Rarer Candy
description: Increases all party members’ level by 1.

name: Evolution Item
description: A random evolution item that a party member can use right now.

name: Rare Evolution Item
description: A random evolution item that a party member can use right now.

name: Form Change Item
description: A random form-change item (Mega Stones, Z-Crystals, etc.) for a party member.

name: Rare Form Change Item
description: A random form-change item (Mega Stones, Z-Crystals, etc.) for a party member.

name: Treasures
description: This Pokémon loves treasure! Keep collecting treasure and something might happen!

name: Mega Bracelet
description: Mega Stones become available.

name: Dynamax Band
description: Max Mushrooms become available.

name: Tera Orb
description: Allows your Pokémon to Terastallize. Recharges slowly. Tera Shards also become available.

name: Map
description: Allows you to choose your destination at a crossroads.

name: Potion
description: Restores 20 HP or 10% HP for one Pokémon, whichever is higher.

name: Super Potion
description: Restores 50 HP or 25% HP for one Pokémon, whichever is higher.

name: Hyper Potion
description: Restores 200 HP or 50% HP for one Pokémon, whichever is higher.

name: Max Potion
description: Fully restores HP for one Pokémon.

name: Full Restore
description: Fully restores HP for one Pokémon and heals any status ailment.

name: Revive
description: Revives one Pokémon and restores 50% HP.

name: Max Revive
description: Revives one Pokémon and restores 100% HP.

name: Full Heal
description: Heals any status ailment for one Pokémon.

name: Sacred Ash
description: Revives all fainted Pokémon, fully restoring HP.

name: Reviver Seed
description: Revives the holder for 1/2 HP upon fainting from a direct hit.

name: White Herb
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle.

name: Ether
description: Restores 10 PP for one Pokémon move.

name: Max Ether
description: Restores all PP for one Pokémon move.

name: Elixir
description: Restores 10 PP for all of one Pokémon’s moves.

name: Max Elixir
description: Restores all PP for all of one Pokémon’s moves.

name: PP Up
description: Permanently increases PP for one Pokémon move by 1 for every 5 maximum PP (maximum 3).

name: PP Max
description: Permanently increases PP for one Pokémon move by 3 for every 5 maximum PP (maximum 3).

name: Lure
description: Quadruples the chance of an encounter being a double battle for up to 10 battles.

name: Super Lure
description: Quadruples the chance of an encounter being a double battle for up to 15 battles.

name: Max Lure
description: Quadruples the chance of an encounter being a double battle for up to 30 battles.

name: Species Stat Booster
description: A species-specific held item (e.g. Light Ball, Thick Club) for a party member.

name: Rare Species Stat Booster
description: A species-specific held item (e.g. Light Ball, Thick Club) for a party member.

name: Temp Stat Stage Booster
description: A random X-item that raises a stat stage for the next 5 battles.

name: Dire Hit
description: Increases the Critical Hit Ratio of all party members by 1 stage for up to 5 battles.

name: Base Stat Booster
description: A random vitamin that raises one base stat of a Pokémon.

name: Attack Type Booster
description: A random type-boosting held item matching a party member's moves.

name: Mint
description: A random Mint that changes a Pokémon's nature.

name: Mystical Rock
description: Extends the duration of terrain and weather caused by the holder’s moves or Abilities by 2 turns.

name: Tera Shard
description: A random Tera Shard that changes a Pokémon's Tera type (rarely Stellar).

name: Berry
description: A random berry for a party member to hold — Sitrus, Lum and Leppa are the most common.

name: TM (Common)
description: A random TM compatible with a party member, drawn from this tier's TM pool.

name: TM (Great)
description: A random TM compatible with a party member, drawn from this tier's TM pool.

name: TM (Ultra)
description: A random TM compatible with a party member, drawn from this tier's TM pool.

name: Memory Mushroom
description: Recall one Pokémon’s forgotten move.

name: Exp. All
description: Non-participants receive 20% of a single participant’s Exp. Points.

name: Exp. Balance
description: Weighs Exp. Points received from battles towards lower-leveled party members.

name: Oval Charm
description: When multiple Pokémon participate in a battle, each gets an extra 10% of the total Exp.

name: Exp. Charm
description: Increases gain of Exp. Points by 25%.

name: Super Exp. Charm
description: Increases gain of Exp. Points by 60%.

name: Golden Exp. Charm
description: Increases gain of Exp. Points by 100%.

name: Lucky Egg
description: Increases the holder’s gain of Exp. Points by 40%.

name: Golden Egg
description: Increases the holder’s gain of Exp. Points by 100%.

name: Soothe Bell
description: Increases friendship gain by 50%.

name: Scope Lens
description: It’s a lens for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder’s critical-hit ratio.

name: Leek
description: This very long and stiff stalk of leek boosts the critical-hit ratio of Farfetch’d’s moves.

name: Eviolite
description: This mysterious evolutionary lump boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats when held by a Pokémon that can still evolve.

name: Soul Dew
description: Increases the influence of a Pokémon’s nature on its stats by 10% (additive).

name: Nugget
description: Grants a small amount of money (₽×1).

name: Big Nugget
description: Grants a moderate amount of money (₽×2.5).

name: Relic Gold
description: Grants a large amount of money (₽×10).

name: Amulet Coin
description: Increases money rewards by 20%.

name: Golden Punch
description: Grants 50% of direct damage inflicted as money.

name: Coin Case
description: After every 10th battle, receive 10% of your money in interest.

name: Lock Capsule
description: Allows you to lock item rarities when rerolling items.

name: Grip Claw
description: Upon attacking, there is a X% chance the foe’s held item will be stolen.

name: Wide Lens
description: Increases move accuracy by X.

name: Multi Lens
description: Converts 25% of damage from the holder’s attacks into an additional strike.

name: Healing Charm
description: Increases the effectiveness of HP restoring moves and items by 10% (excludes Revives).

name: Candy Jar
description: Increases the number of levels added by Rare Candy items by 1.

name: Berry Pouch
description: Adds a 30% chance that a used berry will not be consumed.

name: Focus Band
description: Adds a 10% chance to survive with 1 HP after being damaged enough to faint.

name: Quick Claw
description: Adds a 10% chance to move first regardless of speed (after priority).

name: King’s Rock
description: Adds a 10% chance an attack move will cause the opponent to flinch.

name: Leftovers
description: Heals 1/16 of a Pokémon’s maximum HP every turn.

name: Shell Bell
description: Heals 1/8 of a Pokémon’s dealt damage.

name: Toxic Orb
description: It’s a bizarre orb that exudes toxins when touched and will badly poison the holder during battle.

name: Flame Orb
description: It’s a bizarre orb that gives off heat when touched and will affect the holder with a burn during battle.

name: Baton
description: Allows passing along effects when switching Pokémon, which also bypasses traps.

name: Shiny Charm
description: Dramatically increases the chance of a wild Pokémon being Shiny.

name: Ability Charm
description: Dramatically increases the chance of a wild Pokémon having a Hidden Ability.

name: Catching Charm
description: Increases the chance of getting a critical catch.

name: IV Scanner
description: Enables scanning the IVs of wild Pokémon.

name: DNA Splicers
description: Combines two Pokémon (transfers Ability, splits base stats and types, shares move pool).

name: Mini Black Hole
description: Every turn, the holder acquires one held item from the foe.

name: Voucher
description: Receive X ×1.

name: Voucher Plus
description: Receive X ×1.

name: Voucher Premium
description: Receive X ×1.

name: Golden Poké Ball
description: Adds 1 extra item option at the end of every battle.

name: Damage Token
description: Increases damage by 5%.

name: Protection Token
description: Reduces incoming damage by 2.5%.

name: Recovery Token
description: Heals 2% of max HP every turn.

name: Poison Token
description: Adds a X% chance to inflict X with attack moves.

name: Paralyze Token
description: Adds a X% chance to inflict X with attack moves.

name: Burn Token
description: Adds a X% chance to inflict X with attack moves.

name: Full Heal Token
description: Adds a 2.5% chance every turn to heal a status condition.

name: Endure Token
description: Adds a X% chance of enduring a hit.

name: Fusion Token
description: Adds a 1% chance that a wild Pokémon will be a fusion.

name: Old Gateau
description: Increases some of the holder’s stats.

name: Black Sludge
description: The stench is so powerful that shops will only sell you items at a steep cost increase.

name: Macho Brace
description: Defeating a Pokémon grants the holder a stack of it. Each stack boosts stats a bit. Bonus at max stacks.

name: Golden Bug Net
description: Imbues the owner with luck to find Bug Type Pokémon more often. Has a strange heft to it.
